content.text: {"problem": {"theorem": "证明若 x,y 为实数且 x=y，则 x^2=y^2。", "assumptions": ["x,y 为实数且 x=y。"], "domain": "elementary_algebra", "explicit_subgoals": []}, "target": {"node_id": "n2", "version": 1}, "target_node": {"text": "因此 x^2=y^2。", "claim": "由 x·x=y·y 及平方的定义，得出目标 x^2=y^2。", "scope": [], "depends_on": ["n1"]}, "closed_predecessors": [{"node_id": "n1", "version": 1, "claim": "意图由假设 x=y 得到 x·x=y·y。分别乘以不同量并非一般的等式保持规则；此处还需使用 x=y 说明两个乘数相等。", "text": "等式两边分别乘以 x 和 y。", "scope": [], "depends_on": []}], "patch": {"base_state_digest": "7840b8fde73e81c3d829ec0cc6f2a718253d80b552a63e60a735cdd220e351da", "certificate_id": "48dd4c1fcdf3f7a1f63c54b655f74c2f67d4089236c398552af4f1dbef325a03", "target": {"node_id": "n2", "version": 1}, "operation": "insert_before", "nodes": [{"node_id": "n3", "text": "由假设 x=y，两边同乘 x 得 x·x=y·x；两边同乘 y 得 x·y=y·y。又由乘法交换律 y·x=x·y，故由等式传递性得到 x·x=y·y。", "claim": "由假设 x=y，利用等式两边同乘同一实数、乘法交换律和等式传递性，严格推出 x·x=y·y。", "depends_on": [], "scope": [], "goal_refs": []}], "target_dependencies_after": ["n3"], "counterexample": null, "reason": "新增桥接节点直接从全局假设 x=y 严格证明 n2 所需的 x·x=y·y，并将 n2 的依赖改为该节点；随后按平方定义即可得到 x^2=y^2。"}, "patch_digest": "fe0ca4f43dbb3adc1abdf833516891a8de555c62d77ea4035fbb8cac6409c8df", "certificate": {"certificate_id": "48dd4c1fcdf3f7a1f63c54b655f74c2f67d4089236c398552af4f1dbef325a03", "problem_digest": "bc6e1e8fdbb955a2832e5103f2e24d8601ade22a0926480dd84e25b03171c8a3", "target": {"node_id": "n2", "version": 1}, "graph_digest": "2530a001acb9a8cea4fd67ccd71d956e429674f671ce68e7a7a69db812b313c2", "confirmation": "confirmed", "kind": "gap", "failed_edge": "n1 -> n2", "quote": "因此 x^2=y^2。", "reason": "平方定义确可将已证的 x·x=y·y 改写为 x^2=y^2；但 n1 仅说两边分别乘以 x 和 y，并未严格证明 x·x=y·y。分别乘以不同因子不是一般的等式保持规则，故该依赖不足以支持 n2。"}, "proposed_proof": "等式两边分别乘以 x 和 y。\n由假设 x=y，两边同乘 x 得 x·x=y·x；两边同乘 y 得 x·y=y·y。又由乘法交换律 y·x=x·y，故由等式传递性得到 x·x=y·y。\n因此 x^2=y^2。"}
